learnings: The audit tool should not downgrade the overall package verdict to 'inconclusive' if a tool error occurs on a non-executable metadata file like .SRCINFO, provided the executable files (PKGBUILD, .install) are successfully audited and deemed safe.
Implement retry logic or graceful degradation for transient API errors on non-critical files to prevent unnecessary audit failures and false inconclusive verdicts.
